full_judgment: 21. Considering the balance of convenience and inconvenience we find that if any order of injunction at this stage is granted in favour of the petitioners this will surely hinder the development works of the Government and the development scheme which is going financed by the donor agencies will go in vain. After the publication of the E.B. State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 all of these beels/ponds (Jalmahals) of the ex-zaminders vested to the Government free from all incumbrances and permanent lease of these beel lands is prohibited. However, all these points are required to be decided in the main suit after taking proper evidence.
